cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Gracious Command
cards.instruction: Remain warm and appreciative while steadily reducing everyone else’s room to choose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Thank you for finding reunion venues. My garden will make everyone feel at home.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The hall has shelter if it rains.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Such thoughtful planning. I'll put a gazebo in the garden.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll keep the hall reservation as a backup.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're a lifesaver. Cancel it and put the deposit toward my gazebo; then we're all committed.
